# External geographic reference

`indonesia_adm0.geojson` is the simplified Indonesia ADM0 boundary from
[geoBoundaries gbOpen](https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/IDN/ADM0/).

- Boundary ID: `IDN-ADM0-11942859`
- Boundary year represented: 2017
- Source: OpenStreetMap / Wambacher
- Build: geoBoundaries release commit `9469f09`
- License: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0
- Retrieval date: 2026-09-11

The file provides map context only. It is not used as a target, predictor, or
official statement of disputed boundaries.
